intro.heading: 🌟 Introduction to PM Mudra Loan 🌟
intro.content: The PM Mudra Loan is a government-backed scheme that provides financial assistance to small businesses and entrepreneurs in India 🇮🇳. The scheme was launched in 2015 and has been a huge success, with over 1 crore loans sanctioned to date 📈. In this article, we will guide you through the process of applying for a PM Mudra Loan online in 2026 📆.

sections.heading: 📝 Eligibility Criteria for PM Mudra Loan 📝
sections.content: To be eligible for a PM Mudra Loan, you must meet the following criteria: 🤔 you must be an Indian citizen, you must be above 18 years of age, and you must have a business plan or proposal 📊. Additionally, you must not have any existing loans or debts that are overdue 🚫. The loan amount can range from ₹50,000 to ₹10 lakhs, and the interest rate is competitive, starting from 8.5% per annum 📈.

sections.heading: 📁 Required Documents for PM Mudra Loan 📁
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan, you will need to provide the following documents: 📝 identity proof (Aadhaar card, PAN card, etc.), address proof (passport, driving license, etc.), business proof (registration certificate, tax returns, etc.), and bank statement 🏦. You may also need to provide additional documents, such as a business plan or proposal, depending on the lender's requirements 📊.

sections.heading: 👉 Step-by-Step Guide to Apply for PM Mudra Loan Online 👈
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan online, follow these steps: 📝 visit the official website of the lender or the PM Mudra Loan portal, fill out the online application form with your personal and business details 📊, upload the required documents 📁, and submit the application 🚀. You will receive a confirmation message or email once your application is submitted, and the lender will review your application and verify your documents 📝. If your application is approved, you will receive the loan amount in your bank account within a few days 📈.

faqs.q: What is the interest rate for PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The interest rate for PM Mudra Loan starts from 8.5% per annum and can vary depending on the lender and the loan amount 📈.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get a PM Mudra Loan?
faqs.a: The processing time for a PM Mudra Loan can vary depending on the lender and the complexity of the application, but it typically takes 7-10 working days to get the loan amount 📆.
